Dear customer,

Thank you for contacting us.

Please note that Jordan Brown Q3 belongs to the prestige fleet and all drivers must be over 25 years old to drive this type of vehicle.

Second driver costs 7,5€+tax 24% per day.

All drivers must present upon arrival their driving license & ID in physical form.

Note that you cannot cross the borders with Hertz.

Kind Regards

From: Mazda Hewitt <user7@sample.net>
Sent: Saturday, July 5, 2025 2:41 PM
To: info58@fake.ch
Subject: Request: 3 Drivers & Cross‑Border Coverage – Jordan Brown Q3 Rental (Athens, Aug 3–14 2025)

CAUTION: This email was sent from an external sender. Please always check the sender's email address and not just the displayed name. Do not click on links or open attachments unless you recognize the sender and know that the content is safe.


I hope this message finds you well.

We are planning to rent an Jordan Brown Q3 (or similar) from your Athens location from Sunday, August 3 to Thursday, August 14, 2025 — a total of 11 days. I would like to confirm a few details before finalizing the booking.

We would like to register three drivers for the rental:

  *   Myself
  *   My wife (age 50)
  *   Our daughter Kyra (age 21), license holder for 2 years 10 months

Could you kindly confirm:

  1.  Whether all three of us are eligible to be registered as drivers under this booking
  2.  If there are any additional fees or documentation required for the third driver
  3.  Whether cross-border travel to North Macedonia is permitted for this vehicle/class, and if so, what the insurance and documentation requirements are

We’re looking forward to a scenic and comfortable trip across northern Greece and possibly into North Macedonia, and want to ensure everything is in order well ahead of time.

Thank you in advance for your help — we greatly appreciate your assistance.

Warm regards,

Mazda Hewitt
